items.title: Bucky Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: You know when I play with Ross Tompkins

ctx.x: Well I enjoyed listening to you last night in good company here in Aspen and I was struck by your attack on the guitar. You have a very strong attack.
Well I feel like that. You know when I play with Ross Tompkins and — who is the other piano player who played last night?
